message: Arrange 10 3×3 droplets in an array starting at (60, 15), with a gap of 13. Then generate another 10 2×3 droplets, each with an edge-to-edge gap of 8 on the right side of its corresponding droplet, and merge each pair.

result.assistantReply: 已在起始点(60,15)排列10个3×3液滴，间距13（即右上方的列间距为13）。随后在每个3×3液滴左侧生成对应的2×3液滴，边到边间隔8，并合成10组。
